title: Modernize VB Forms to C#
problem_statement: Legacy VB forms need to be rewritten in C# to align with modern development practices.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated technology may lead to increased maintenance costs and security risks.
suggested_approach: Use WinForms or WPF for the C# implementation of the forms.
success_criteria: All forms are functional in C# with equivalent or improved functionality.
No critical bugs are present in the new implementation.
